intl.title: NDSU - International undergraduate admission (apply, English proficiency, dates)

cost.title: NDSU - International tuition and cost information

test_policy.notes: NDSU is test-optional: ACT/SAT are not required for admission and decisions rely on high school GPA and core coursework; scores may be sent and are also used for math and English placement. Recommended GPA 2.75+ (4.0 scale) and 14 core high school units.

requirements.notes: The $35 fee is the international undergraduate application fee. International first-year applicants need a U.S.-equivalent GPA of 2.75 or higher (transcripts evaluated in-house) and English proficiency; unofficial transcripts are uploaded with the application, official ones are mailed after admission. The domestic application fee was not checked.

deadlines.label: International recommended deadline, fall 2027 (August start)
deadlines.notes: Page states May 15 for the Fall 2026 semester; treated as the same date for fall 2027. Rolling admission, documents evaluated as received. Spring entry: November 1.

deadlines.label: Domestic first-year application deadline, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Domestic first-year page lists Fall 2027 applications by August 1; decisions typically 2-3 weeks after materials are complete. Shown for reference; international students use the earlier recommended date.

deadlines.label: Admitted by this date for automatic international scholarship (August start)
deadlines.notes: Applicants admitted before July 1 (fall) are considered automatically; no separate scholarship application.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt: citizens of listed English-speaking countries (e.g. Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, New Zealand, Nigeria, UK, Ghana); 2 years in good standing at a post-secondary institution in a listed country; 2 years at a U.S. high school or regionally accredited U.S. college; English Composition 1 and 2 with B or higher; U.S. GED taken in English. Scores valid 2 years. ACT English 18 or SAT EBRW 480 also meets the requirement.

english.notes: For tests taken on/after 2026-01-21; page lists '4.0' without naming the 1-6 scale.

aid.notes: Automatic international scholarship by U.S.-equivalent GPA, up to 8 semesters: 3.5-4.0 = $12,000 ($1,500/semester); 3.0-3.49 = $8,000 ($1,000/semester). NDSU states it offers no full scholarships. Applicants may also be considered for conditional admission. CDS H6 (2024-25): only institutional non-need-based aid for nonresidents; 53 received it, average $8,382.

cost.notes: International base-rate undergraduate tuition AND fees estimate for 2 semesters of 12 credits ($753.32 tuition + $71.70 fees per credit); engineering $21,862. The cost page does not label the academic year. Housing $4,885 (shared) + 7-day meal plan $5,762 = $10,647. Also listed: ISS support fee $250, health insurance $2,190, one-time $200 new student fee. Page total $34,287 (base rate). Domestic tuition not checked.
